addressed.change: Use unrounded fraction in accrued_interest instead of 10-place quantized fraction
Validate principal decimal places via exponent < -2 instead of quantize equality so trailing-zero inputs like '10.000' are rejected
Guard ACT/ACT_ISDA year-boundary construction for year 9999 so periods within 9999 compute without date(10000,1,1) overflow
Remove CENT quantize from principal validation to accept large principals with <=2 decimals without default-precision InvalidOperation

claims.title: Principal with trailing zero beyond two decimal places is accepted
ACT/ACT_ISDA fails for dates in year 9999
Valid principal exceeding 28 significant digits is rejected
